prerequisites: Algorithms and Data Structures (Algoritmi e Strutture Dati)

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the principles on which the web is based and the technologies that have been established during its evolution.
Know the design principles of a web application.
Understand the fundamental constructs of HTML.
Know how to create static web pages.
Understand the fundamental constructs of CSS.
Know how to create static and dynamic style sheets for web pages.
Understand the fundamental constructs of PHP.
Know how to implement the business logic of a web application and integrate a database.
Understand the fundamental constructs of Javascript.
Know how to implement dynamic web pages using client-side programming languages.
Understand the principles of designing a dynamic website.
Know how to design a dynamic website starting from the requirement analysis.
Know how to set up a development server.
Know how to design the user interface using wireframe and wireflow.
Understand the fundamental constructs of HTML and HTML5.
Know how to develop static web pages with HTML5.
Know how to develop responsive websites.
Know how to define the layout of a website and create a responsive web image gallery and navigation bar.
Know how to implement the restricted area of a website.
Know how to handle DOM events.
Know how to transfer data between client and server with AJAX.
Methods and technologies for web application design and implementation.
Markup languages and style sheet languages.
Server-side and client-side programming languages.
Design and develop static and/or dynamic websites by selecting the most suitable technologies.
Implement software components for websites and web applications to be integrated on both the client side and the server side.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the World Wide Web and Web Technologies
Introduction to the analysis of requirements, and the design of a Web application
Case studies of Web application development
In-depth study of the HTML language
In-depth study of the CSS language
CSS: Selectors, Box Model and Layout
Box Model and Layout in CSS
In-depth study of the PHP language
Introduction to Relational Databases and SQL
Cookies and Session Management in PHP
In-depth study of the Javascript language
User interface design by wireframe and wireflow
Develop static web pages with HTML elements, semantic HTML5 elements and advanced HTML5 elements: Canvas, Drag & Drop, and Geolocation
Use CSS to define the website layout
Create an image gallery and a navigation bar with CSS
Create a responsive website with CSS
Design and implementation of a database for a web application
Implementation of PHP scripts to connect to and query a database
Implementation of the restricted area of a website using PHP sessions and cookies
Transferring data between the browser and a server in the background with AJAX
assessment_rules: The exam is composed of a project work and an oral examination. The project work evaluates the student's ability to design and implement dynamic websites. The oral examination assesses the knowledge and skills acquired by the student, with a focus on the personal contribution to the project work and theoretical topics. Students obtain the maximum grade when they are able to discuss and motivate their design and implementation choices and correctly discuss theoretical topics.
